To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of LBP and LBP Top algorithms for feature selection and extraction of facial images from video sequences can increase the accuracy of facial expressions detection in a video sequence.
the use of local feature extraction algorithms like LBP TOP and LDP for facial expression detection in video sequences is better than holistic approaches like GLCM and LDA.
LBP TOP, LBP TOP + LDP and LBP TOP + SVM + GA outperformed other algorithms in the study.

facial expression recognition from video sequences.
the analysis of facial images and video sequences in 3D.
the development of a robust and accurate facial expression recognition system using local facial extraction algorithm for feature extraction.

local facial extraction algorithms are better than holistic algorithms.
the local feature extraction algorithms have better recognition rates than the holistic algorithms.

the use of LBP and LDP for feature extraction and SVM for classification has been shown to be effective for facial expression analysis.
